crawler.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art sprite sheet for the existing Godot top-down 2D game Horda Sombria.
Reference image: the provided monsters-walk-v1.png contains FOUR species in rows. Use ONLY the small purple spider/crawler in the FIRST ROW as the identity reference. Do not include the eye, humanoid beast or armored colossus.
Create ONE new separate sheet for this SAME spider, preserving its dark purple fluffy/spiky body, two small glowing orange/red eyes, ivory hooked legs, dark nearly black outline, low-res crisp pixel clusters and proportions. Do not redesign its identity.
Layout: exactly THREE ROWS and SIX COLUMNS, 18 complete sprites total on a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background, no painted backdrop, no checkerboard, no ground, no glow cloud, no text or labels or borders.
Requested canvas 1536 by 1024. Use an evenly spaced strict 6x3 grid, sprite centered at the same position inside each cell, generous transparent separation between cells and sheet edges.
ROW 1: six-frame seamless walking/scuttling cycle FACING RIGHT, full side profile with the face/eyes on the RIGHT end. Must actually face right, not front.
ROW 2: six-frame seamless scuttling cycle FACING DOWN toward viewer, symmetric front view, both eyes visible, clear alternating left/right leg contacts.
ROW 3: six-frame seamless scuttling cycle FACING UP away from viewer: rear of spider visible, no eyes visible, back tuft silhouette and rear legs.
All six frames within a row maintain the SAME view, SAME body volume and pixel style. This is animation, not a turnaround sequence across columns. Change limb poses across columns: contact A, passing A, lift A, contact B (opposite legs), passing B, lift B. No duplicate half-cycles, no changing size, no extra or missing legs. Ground contacts remain on a common horizontal baseline for each row; no whole-body horizontal drift, no clipping.
Use the same elevated top-down three-quarter camera as the game sprites while making the front, back, right views unambiguous. Solid readable limited palette, consistent lighting from upper left. The fourth direction will be mirrored in Godot, so do NOT add a fourth row.
